تقتطعون (form VIII)
# تَقْتَطِعُونَ (taqtaṭiʕūna) /taq.ta.tˤi.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
# تُقْتَطَعُونَ (tuqtaṭaʕūna) /tuq.ta.tˤa.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
